g.text: build SGL for target RDMA READ
Boundary: Falcon RDMA link (100 GbE, MTU 4096).
Both IPUs do fabric offload only — no NVMe logic.
Pull model: initiator sends NVMe WRITE command capsule;
target-side nvmet-rdma issues an RDMA READ back to the
initiator's pre-registered TX MR. The target RDMA engine
schedules the pull; there is no admission gate on target.
